Turns the items into others with TypeScript: run(items, ctx) is called once with all of them and returns the items to send on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `code.transform` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Code (`source`) | TypeScript; see [Code nodes](/docs/guides/code/) | no | a starter, below | TypeScript, importing only from @polythought/sdk: dec for exact prices, data requests, and the types of every node's items. |

## Starter code

What **Code** holds until you change it:

```ts
import type { Context, Item } from "@polythought/sdk"

// Called once with every item; returns the items to send on.
export function run(items: Item[], ctx: Context): Item[] {
  return items.map((item) => ({ ...item, seenAt: ctx.execution.startedAt }))
}
```
